content:
**Braxson's Quality Medical Supplies** is a location in The Mire region of Appalachia.

Located in an isolated, remote corner of Appalachia, Braxson's has been delivering quality medical education supplies to medical schools throughout the United States. These were predominantly anatomical models crafted from cadavers obtained by the company.

The building is a large yellow brick warehouse in which a variety of different creatures can spawn. Approaching the main entrance on the northern side, the first room is a large workspace for assembling Skeletons. The whole area is full of junk, namely, Bones. To the east is an empty loading bay. Continuing south into the building is a large hall with a staircase and catwalk along the lefthand wall. Under this are more Bones and a Port-A-Diner. The hall ends with an Armor Workbench and a door to the east. To the west is another loading bay with a Tinker's Workbench. Outside the eastern door is a fenced-in area with a Fusion Generator on its north side, possibly containing a Fusion Core. The parking lot is the possible location of a random encounter.

Braxson's Quality Medical Supplies appears in *Fallout 76*.
